title: Initial object
description: JSON Schema for an initial object — an object I in a category C such that for every object A there exists a unique morphism I → A (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3; Awodey 2010 §3.4). Dual to terminal-object. Initial objects are unique up to unique isomorphism when they exist. The schema records the witness via a const-pinned subtree, dualized from the terminal-object pattern.

in-category.description: The name of the category C in which this initial object lives.

initial-witness.description: The universal-property witness pinned by const. Every initial-object instance carries this exact subtree; the const constraint forces uniformity.
